thesisQuality.note: Exceptional current adoption and revenue growth in power management support durable demand, tempered by concentration and substitution risk.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: 47.6% YoY Q2 growth and materially higher Q3 guide show exceptional operating acceleration.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: About 84x trailing earnings and $67.85B market cap require aggressive outcomes despite strong growth.

catalystScore.note: Q3 growth guide and manufacturing partnership are identifiable near-term catalysts with source support.

governancePower.note: Current proxy supports established governance and incentive structures, while the 2026 restatement prevents a stronger transparency score.

alignment2036.note: Efficient power conversion is foundational across AI compute, communications, automotive and industrial electrification.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: Core power-management capability serves Enterprise Data, storage/computing, automotive, industrial and communications markets.

bottleneckControl.note: Power conversion is a critical constraint in high-density compute, but MPS does not exclusively control the layer.

scenarioRobustness.note: Multiple end markets diversify demand, offset by rising Enterprise Data concentration.

substitutionResilience.note: Design/qualification barriers support resilience, but architecture shifts and competing socket wins remain credible.

supplyChainResilience.note: Diversification actions are positive, but fabless third-party manufacturing remains a material dependency and partnership ramp is unproven.

pricingPower.note: Rapid growth and specialized power content imply strong value capture, though current evidence does not prove structurally protected pricing across cycles.

risk.note: Demand concentration, high valuation, outsourced supply, substitution risk and restatement history create above-moderate risk.

confidence.note: Direct SEC financial and governance filings plus current market evidence cover all score dimensions; foundry economics and customer-level concentration remain incomplete.

thesis: MPS has exceptional AI/electrification power-management momentum and cross-market leverage, but valuation and execution expectations are unusually demanding.
keyRisk: AI/server concentration or architecture/socket loss collides with an 84x trailing valuation and outsourced supply dependence.
nextCatalyst: Q3 2026 earnings against the $1.14B-$1.16B revenue guide and evidence of GlobalFoundries ramp conversion.
